Coram : D.K. JAIN*, T.S. THAKUR
LIMITATION ACT, 1963: c s.5 - Condonation of delay in filing appeal by a public sector undertaking - Declined by High Court - Held: - Sufficient cause had been made out for condonation of delay in filing the appeal and, therefore, the High court erred in declining the prayer- It is showing a 0 sufficient cause, a party is not entitled to the condonation of delay as a matter of right, yet it is trite that in construing sufficient cause, courts generally follow a liberal approach, particularly, when no negligence, inaction or ma/a fides can be imputed to the party - It is
